annotator_notes: Viedoc-style annotated eCRF, 1083 pages. A form's first page prints the form title as a heading; continuation pages omit it (form_source=carryover). Machine markers '[OID]' and '[TYPE: ...]' are listed FIRST (often grouped), then the human-readable prompt labels and option values follow positionally. Field = the human-readable prompt; option values, '[TYPE:...]', '[OID]', '[Read-only field]', '[VISIBILITY:...]', 'Row N' markers, and the 'Page N of 1083' footer are NOT fields. Some pages are blank (footer only). Form accuracy is scored only on form_source=printed pages (title verifiable on the page); carryover form_name is best-effort context.
